final_diagnosis.root_cause: The currencyservice Deployment in the boutique namespace references a misspelled container image ('currencyservce' instead of 'currencyservice'), causing Kubernetes to fail pulling the image. The pod is stuck in ErrImagePull, leaving the service with 0/1 ready replicas and unreachable, which degrades the entire boutique app via frontend and checkoutservice dependencies.
final_diagnosis.report:
The currencyservice Deployment in the boutique namespace references a misspelled container image ('currencyservce' instead of 'currencyservice'), causing Kubernetes to fail pulling the image

## Findings
• Pod currencyservice-b68d5576c-gbl9k is in ErrImagePull with error 'image can't be pulled'.
• The Deployment manifest references the misspelled image path 'microservices-demo/currencyservce:v0.10.3'.
• Deployment currencyservice shows 0/1 available replicas; all other boutique deployments are healthy.
• The ClusterIP service currencyservice:80 is not reachable.
• All cluster nodes (master + worker-01/02/03) are Ready with no resource pressure.

*Non-Validated Claims (Inferred):*
• The upstream registry was not directly queried to confirm the misspelled repository does not exist.
• The failure could theoretically be due to registry auth/network rather than the typo, though this is unlikely.
• Downstream user-facing impact on frontend/checkoutservice is inferred from the dependency graph but not confirmed via their logs.

## Recommended Actions
• Fix the image reference in the currencyservice Deployment manifest from '.../microservices-demo/currencyservce:v0.10.3' to '.../microservices-demo/currencyservice:v0.10.3'.
• Apply the corrected manifest with `kubectl apply -f currencyservice.yaml` or `kubectl set image deployment/currencyservice server=us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/google-samples/microservices-demo/currencyservice:v0.10.3 -n boutique`.
• Confirm the new pod reaches Running 1/1 with `kubectl get pods -n boutique -w`.
• Re-test connectivity to currencyservice:80 and run a frontend smoke test.
• Add a CI/CD guardrail (image-name validator or pre-deploy `kubectl create --dry-run=server`) and an alert on ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff.
• Audit other manifests in the repo for similar typos (grep for 'servce', etc.).
